source_read: https://menus.tenkites.com/bills/bills (all 12 menu tabs, downloaded fresh 2026-10-08; robots.txt of menus.tenkites.com allows it)
notes: Independent Playwright DOM read of every pop-up (730 incl. duplicates across menus) matched 364 of 365 published items exactly on calories + contains + may-contain + gluten cereals (the 365th, Hot Chocolate with Cream = 'With Cream +40p' 331 kcal, checked by hand); the vegetarian tag also matches every item. Calories-only chain, so no other nutrients exist to compare. Hazelnut Syrup held back (page prints no allergens for a hazelnut-named syrup). The live page changed since 7 Oct (ice-cream items now named 'Gluten Free ... (no wafer)'), script updated and re-run. Note: the DATA.md schema records gluten cereals only under 'contains', so a cereal named only in 'May contain' (e.g. oats on the macchiatos) is not shown; the three '(gluten-free)' burgers are marked Suitable for Coeliacs by the chain yet list barley as contained, kept as printed.
